card.text: Four clusters of galaxies caught colliding, the first such collision documented.

sources.label: ESA/Hubble opo0917a: NASA, ESA, CXC, C. Ma, H. Ebeling and E. Barrett (University of Hawaii/IfA), et al. and STScI
sources.locator: caption: four separate galaxy clusters have been involved in a collision, the first time such a phenomenon has been documented

sources.locator: z = 0.549: comoving distance 2,109 Mpc, lookback time 5.54 Gyr, age 8244 Myr

introduction.text: Hubble's view with Chandra's X-rays: the purple glow is hot gas slowed by the collision. The picture is flat and has no depth.
